controls.name: Cleves Warsaw Pike / Glenway Avenue / Guerley Road

start.description: I4 joint transform (georef_1912.json), unchanged: grid g0 = CoonsInverse(p); q = p + 2*(J.F(g0) + S(p/2 - (u0, v0))); grid = CoonsInverse(q) (feet); ground = AEQD(origin, WGS84) -> EPSG:26916
start.shape_basis: monomials a^i b^j, i+j in 2..3, a=(u/2-u0)/W, b=(v/2-v0)/H
start.neatline_t: neatline offsets sampled at t = linspace(0, 1, 401) along each edge

correction.description: ground = start(p) + D(start(p)); D is this thin-plate spline (metres)
correction.kernel: r^2 log r, r = |x - c| / scale
